goal: Update slugify: lowercase ASCII letters, replace each run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and remove leading/trailing hyphens. Empty or punctuation-only input returns an empty string.

Update truncate: if text exceeds limit, return a string of at most limit characters ending in a single Unicode ellipsis (which counts as one character). A non-positive limit returns empty; unchanged text fits as-is. Inputs use BMP characters and integer limits.
Update initials to use the first letter of each whitespace-separated word, uppercase, taking at most two words. Ignore surrounding and repeated whitespace; blank input returns empty.
Update median to compute the numeric median of an unsorted array without mutating it. Even length uses the mean of the two middle values; an empty array returns 0.

Update formatCents to format integer cents with exactly two decimal places and a minus before the amount for negative cents. Update receipt to trim its label and prefix the formatted amount with $. Example: receipt(" Tea ", -125) is "Tea: $-1.25".
Update unique_words to split on whitespace, lowercase words, and deduplicate preserving first appearance. Punctuation remains part of a word. Blank input returns an empty list.

Update camel_to_snake to convert camelCase and PascalCase identifiers to lowercase snake_case. Keep acronym runs together, splitting before the next capitalized word (HTTPServer -> http_server). Existing underscores remain.
Update clamp to return value restricted to the inclusive range low..high. Raise ValueError if low exceeds high. Support integers and floats.

Update chunked to partition a list into consecutive lists of size elements, preserving a final shorter chunk. Empty input returns []; size <= 0 raises ValueError. Do not mutate the input. Size is an integer.

Update format_cents to format integer cents with exactly two decimal places and a minus before the amount for negative cents. Update receipt to trim its label and prefix the formatted amount with $. Example: receipt(" Tea ", -125) is "Tea: $-1.25".
